name: Top bar
tagline: A slim menu bar along the top
description: A slim dark bar across the whole top edge, like a menu bar: Start at the left, your running apps after it, and the clock with the weekday, the network, the volume, the battery (on a laptop) and the notification bell at the right. Icons stay small and do not magnify. It never hides, and maximized windows start below it. Pair it with a dock at the bottom for your pinned apps.
